# Majestic Permits

Majestic Permits files, tracks, and closes out building permits for contractors and homeowners in Miami-Dade, Broward, and Palm Beach County, Florida.

Phone: (561) 888-3805
Email: angelique@majesticpermits.com
Site: https://www.majesticpermits.com/
Request more info: https://www.majesticpermits.com/#info
Contractor login: https://hub.majesticpermits.com

A request on the public site does not open a permit. New permits are requested inside the hub after the company is a client.

## Expired permits

The Permit Closer is part of Majestic Permits. It answers letters about open or expired permits. The free report asks for a name, an email, and the address on the letter.

https://www.majesticpermits.com/permit-closer

## Cities

Every municipality in the three counties has a page under https://www.majesticpermits.com/areas/
Full list: https://www.majesticpermits.com/sitemap.xml
